name: HD Duel
author: Unchiga
description: The duel redrawn at 4x from your own disc: the platform of all seven fields, the hand's card frames, their words and numbers, the FIELD box and the life points. Shows best at View > Internal 4x.
capture: A campaign duel from a cold boot (tests/pc/smoke/duel-hand-camera.json's input), dumped with MEMORIES_DUMP_TEXTURES_FROM once the duel began; the arena is drawn by one code for every field, so the normal field's pieces are every field's, at each package's offsets.
